top_signals.title: Bond Veteran Jim Bianco Turns Bullish for First Time Since 2020
top_signals.summary: Jim Bianco, a Wall Street veteran and longtime market watcher, is turning bullish on US Treasuries for the first time in six years after benchmark yields surged to two-decade highs, creating an enticing entry point.
